headline: Why Our Model Likes Detroit
caption:
One factor is doing most of the work in Celtics at Pistons 🏀

That factor is team efficiency: how many points each team scores and allows per trip down the floor. It moves our model 0.5 pts toward Detroit. Tonight's players add 0.1 more for DET, and Boston's recent point differential pulls 0.1 back their way. All of that sits on a baseline where the average home team is favored by 2.3.

The pick: Detroit Pistons, 59%. A lean, not a lock. Boston wins this one 41% of the time.

Does efficiency carry Detroit, or do the Celtics steal one on the road?
